title: Cute Plates, but Handle with Care
text:
Cute Plates, but Handle with Care. Little Hoot and the Snowman 4- piece dessert plate gift set is a nice way to celebrate the holiday season. The small plates are just right for serving small portions of food and the design fits in nicely during this time of year.

I haven't used many Rachel Ray cookware or dish products, but these plates certainly seem like a nice set based on appearance. With the cute design, these plates could even be used as a display inside a china cabinet during the holidays. Kids and others will like the snowman and owl design and they make a good gift choice for those who like festive, holiday- specific gift items.

I agree with others who rave about the cuteness of these plates, but I also agree with a few who question their overall craftsmanship and durability. Rub your fingers across the surface of the plates and you will quickly notice that they are not smooth like a plate should be. In addition, they are quite light and seem very delicate. I am very careful when I have used them because they seem prone to shattering at the slightest mishandling. Nothing has gone wrong yet, but I am glad they are meant only for the holidays because they do not seem made to last.

Aside from the questionable construction, however, this four- piece dessert plate set seems like a nice way to put you in the holiday frame of mind. The colors and the design fit perfectly with the winter season and they make a good serving option for desserts and other, smaller fare. Just try your best to handle with care- they may not last long otherwise.
